# Normalize EMG by MVC or peak

Normalize EMG by MVC or peak

## Usage

``` r
normalizeEMG(x, method = c("mvc", "peak"), mvc = NULL, scale_percent = TRUE)
```

## Arguments

- x:

  Numeric vector or matrix (time x channels).

- method:

  Normalization method: `"mvc"` or `"peak"`.

- mvc:

  Numeric scalar or vector of MVC reference values. Required when
  `method = "mvc"`.

- scale_percent:

  Logical; if `TRUE`, returns percent scale (x100).

## Value

Normalized signal with same dimensions as `x`.

## References

Merletti R, Parker PA (2004). "Electromyography: Physiology,
Engineering, and Non-Invasive Applications." IEEE Press/Wiley.

## See also

[`rectifyEMG()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioMoCap/reference/rectifyEMG.md)
for signal rectification,
[`computeRMSEnvelope()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioMoCap/reference/computeRMSEnvelope.md)
for RMS envelope computation,
[`processEMG()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioMoCap/reference/processEMG.md)
for complete EMG processing pipeline.

## Examples

``` r
x <- matrix(abs(rnorm(500)), ncol = 2)
normalizeEMG(x, method = "peak")
```
